paper.abstract_en: Homotopy algebraic methods have become increasingly influential in the study of field theories. We consider semi-holomorphic Chern--Simons theory and its relation with the principal chiral model. The semi-classical equivalence of the two theories is expected on general grounds, as the principal chiral model arises by eliminating trivial pairs and gauge fixing. We construct this equivalence explicitly as an off-shell, cyclic quasi-isomorphism between the cyclic $L_\infty$-algebras governing the two theories, and show that it directly encodes the Lax connection. This provides a concrete example for studying integrability of a two-dimensional system through the homotopy algebraic lens.
